executive_summary: The Android cockpit (apps/android) and the loopback cockpit API (gateway/cockpit) are far more complete than a greenfield mission implies. Chat (live streaming), Memory, Audit, Approvals (with owner phrase), Control/runtime status, Avatar persona, and the Den/Room are wired end-to-end to the real backend. The dominant gap is that several real backend capabilities are exposed by the cockpit server but consumed by NO Android screen: most importantly the orchestration Job Queue (contract v4: list/dispatch/run/cancel). The generic getRaw passthrough is used only in tests, so models, skills, sessions, navigation, proposals, events, and diagnostics endpoints are also unwired on mobile. Research Vault, TokenJuice, model scorecards, and ledger replay are not exposed through the cockpit at all (backend/CLI-only). The recommended path is to wire already-built backend surfaces into the existing app (extend, do not duplicate), starting with the Job Queue + owner-gated run.

architecture_map.desktop_web_ui: hermes_cli/web_server.py (FastAPI /api/* : status, sessions, config, model management, gateway restart, hermes update) — a SEPARATE API surface from the cockpit /v1/cockpit/*.
